question: Has Dabur been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Dabur now?
markdown:
Dabur has not been acquired or merged into another company
. Instead,
Dabur India Limited
remains a publicly traded Indian multinational consumer goods company that is controlled and promoted by the founding
Burman family
, who hold a majority ownership stake alongside public and institutional shareholders.
Dabur
Ownership and Structure
Promoter Ownership:
The
Burman family
retains the dominant promoter stake in Dabur India Ltd.
Management:
Ownership and day-to-day management were separated back in 1998 when the family handed over executive control to professional managers, though they kept their majority shareholding.
Dabur
Recent Corporate Actions
While Dabur has not been bought out, it frequently acts as the
acquiring
entity rather than the target:
Brand Acquisitions:
Dabur acquired a majority stake in Badshah Masala in 2022 and moved to merge Sesa Care into its portfolio in late 2024.
Independent Operations:
The company trades publicly on the NSE and BSE under the management of its executive leadership and board.
